title: Map inbound thinking blocks to reasoning input items for /responses API multi-turn: when an Anthropic-format assistant message contains thinking blocks that originated from GPT-5.x reasoning, translate them back to type=reasoning input items instead of plain text. Blocked until Copilot populates reasoning summaries.

rejection.note: Measured against the live gateway: the malformed empty-ID reasoning item this feature was written to prevent cannot originate from the current /v1/messages path, because thinking is flattened into assistant text before translateRequestToResponses, and two-turn tool loops returned 200 with no reasoning input. Authentic provider-issued reasoning replays with 200 while an empty id is rejected locally with a structured 400, so the reported 502 did not come from this repository. The stated blocker is also stale: it is no longer 'Copilot must populate summaries' but that Anthropic history has no safe representation for a provider-issued opaque reasoning id, its encrypted content and its provenance. A future opaque reasoning-state carrier must be proposed as its own feature rather than resumed here.
